card.name: Contraindication wording before ingredients
card.fires_on: The word just before ingredient, excipient or component terms in hypersensitivity contraindications, e.g. 'or any of the' or 'or any of its'. Also fires on a few nearby spots in allergy and ingredient text.

modes.label: Any of the ingredients
modes.description: Linking word after 'hypersensitivity to X or any of' that leads into ingredients or components.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to deflazacort or any of<< the>> inactive ingredients in deflazacort

modes.label: Excipient or ingredient lists
modes.description: Start or punctuation of excipient wording in contraindications or ingredient lists.
